source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of regulating gene expression (PDF 140-142).

blocks.text: Jandar ke sab genes aik saath zahir nahi hote: mukhtalif genes mukhtalif waqt zahir hote hain. Jism ke sab cells mein aik hi genome hai, lekin har cell mein sab genes on nahi; har qisam ke cell mein khaas genes on hote hain. Genes ko on aur off karna aur un ke zahir hone ka waqt regulator proteins qaboo karte hain, aur is amal ko gene expression ki regulation kehte hain.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: Jigar ke cells enzyme alcohol dehydrogenase ke genes zahir karte hain jo alcohol ko bezarar molecules mein torta hai. Dimagh ke neurons mein bhi yahi genes hain lekin woh unhein off rakhte hain.

blocks.prompt: Har jismani cell mein wahi genes hain. Jigar ke cells neurons se mukhtalif kyun hain?
blocks.explanation: Har qisam ke cell mein genes ke mukhtalif set on hote hain, maslan alcohol dehydrogenase ke genes jigar mein on aur neurons mein off.

items: Sab cells mein aik genome; mukhtalif cells aur waqt mein mukhtalif genes on.
Regulator proteins genes on aur off karte hain.
